# GHOST Demo v1.0 — Third-Party Package License Materials

This catalog includes upstream license/notice files shipped in crates.io archives
for all registry dependencies named in both pinned Cargo.lock files.
The list is intentionally inclusive of development and target-specific dependencies.
An SPDX expression is metadata, not an external legal certification.

GHOST independent demo copyright and permission: see LICENSE-EVALUATION.md.

Materials below include crate archive files, recovered upstream files, source comment notices, and published manifest declarations. Their origins are identified in the respective sections. Supplemental sections update earlier missing-file observations.

# SPDX CANONICAL TEXT RECOVERY — ORIGINAL NOTICE FILES UNAVAILABLE

The original .crate archives for the following 34 locked dependencies did not
contain extractable LICENSE/NOTICE files under the searched names.
This appendix supplies canonical license/exception texts from SPDX,
**not** a claim that package-specific copyright notices were recovered.
Individual copyright, attribution and redistribution requirements
remain subject to rights-holder/legal review.

## Exact crates and their declared SPDX expressions

- `asn1-rs-impl 0.2.0`: `MIT/Apache-2.0` — https://crates.io/crates/asn1-rs-impl/0.2.0
- `base256emoji 1.0.2`: `MIT` — https://crates.io/crates/base256emoji/1.0.2
- `base45 3.2.0`: `MIT` — https://crates.io/crates/base45/3.2.0
- `const-str 0.4.3`: `MIT` — https://crates.io/crates/const-str/0.4.3
- `gloo-timers 0.2.6`: `MIT/Apache-2.0` — https://crates.io/crates/gloo-timers/0.2.6
- `if-watch 3.2.2`: `MIT OR Apache-2.0` — https://crates.io/crates/if-watch/3.2.2
